name: Centurio Multilingual Text-in-Image Understanding Benchmark
description: A new benchmark introduced to evaluate multilingual text-in-image understanding capabilities of large vision-language models across multiple languages and tasks.
reputation: A newer multilingual OCR/text-in-image benchmark that has seen some use in multilingual vision-language evaluation, but is not yet as widely established as major benchmarks like MMMU or TextVQA.
notes: Focuses on multilingual training strategies and includes 100 languages; emphasizes importance of non-English OCR data.
